Compare downloaded files against the tested checksums

Source: R/download_data.R
pg_verify_checksums.Rd

Advisory only. Files without a reference in pgchecksum keep md5_ok as NA and are not treated as problems, which is what makes it possible to download a source for the first time and generate its checksums afterwards.

Usage

pg_verify_checksums(result, destfolder, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

result

data.frame from pg_download_result().

destfolder

Character. Raw data folder.

quiet

Logical. Suppress progress messages.

Value

result with md5_ok filled in where a reference exists.
